value.rationale: The exact best frame-operator condition number, optimum pole height and stability defect are natural quantitative invariants for an entire established family of critical-density Riesz bases. They answer whether mixing positive Cauchy poles can improve stability and quantify near-optimal rigidity. Neither a routine parameter substitution nor a finite-table computation: the comparison includes nontrivial mixed-pole interference and continuous optimization over all mixtures.
